digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync command and reconciler request handling
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a single manifest containing arbitrated plan entries with exact field-level drift from that same pass, without invoking or reimplementing reconcile-check
Canonical bridge preview must not acquire, purge, steal, or write the pass lock; existing pass-lock state and collateral repository/ref state must remain byte-identical after preview executes

The argparse parser must use allow_abbrev=False so that abbreviated or unknown options (e.g., --dry-run as prefix of --dry-run-enumerate) fail with invocation error 2 before any repository read, lock acquisition, or mutation

Canonical bridge preview and canonical bridge sync must emit field-comparable manifest envelopes with the same keys; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest containing exact applied and failed tallies

Legacy reconcile-check (rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check) must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, bridge_state/reconcile-check.json artifact, and exit behavior unchanged
Legacy uncapped LIVE callers through CLI, direct engine, library, MCP, and older workflows must retain the historical tally-only, no-retained-manifest contract
